youtube.baslik: Is one low test enough for an auditory processing difficulty? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Under a widely cited criterion in the 2010 guideline of the American Academy of Audiology, results must fall two standard deviations or more below the norm on at least two different tests, in at least one ear. In the example case, the left ear on dichotic digits and both ears on the frequency pattern test met this criterion. The criterion supports a profile consistent with an auditory processing difficulty; diagnosis is made with the team and physician after comorbid conditions such as attention and language are assessed.
